We are Facet Software (Pty) Ltd ("Company", "we", "us" or "our"), a company registered in South Africa (registration number 2026/750377/07).

We operate the mobile application DeltaLab (the "App"), as well as any other related products and services that refer or link to these legal terms (the "Legal Terms") (collectively, the "Services").

DeltaLab is a mobile app for iPhone and Android. It lets healthcare professionals view laboratory results from the National Health Laboratory Service (NHLS) TrakCare Lab portal more quickly and conveniently on a phone.

DeltaLab is an independent product. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by the NHLS. To use it, you need your own valid NHLS TrakCare portal account and an internet connection. You sign in with your existing portal username and password; there is no separate DeltaLab account. The App connects directly from your device to the NHLS portal on your behalf, and it shows only the records your NHLS account is already allowed to see.

With DeltaLab you can:

  • search for patients by name, hospital number, specimen ID or episode number, or scan a specimen barcode with the phone camera;
  • view a patient's lab episodes and results, including abnormal (high/low) flags, reference ranges and tests still awaiting results;
  • compare results across a patient's episodes in a timeline table;
  • keep a ward-round list that highlights patients with new results, including new microbiology culture results;
  • see recent results for tests you requested;
  • open and share the official NHLS lab report (PDF);
  • generate a printable ward-round handover sheet from a patient's results; and
  • reopen recently viewed patients from your device.

Data and privacy. DeltaLab has no server of its own. Patient information travels only between your device and the NHLS portal; Facet Software never receives, stores or has access to it. Your NHLS login is stored in your device's secure storage (the iOS Keychain or the Android equivalent) and is sent only to the NHLS. Results you view are saved on your device so they can be reopened quickly, and you can delete them at any time in the App. The App contains no advertising, analytics or tracking. You are responsible for keeping your device secure (passcode or biometrics) and for complying with patient-confidentiality obligations, your employer's policies, and the NHLS portal's own terms of use.

Pricing. DeltaLab is free for up to five patients per day. The limit resets at midnight, and reopening a patient already opened that day does not count again. An optional auto-renewing subscription, monthly or annual, removes the daily limit. First-time subscribers may be offered a one-month free trial. Subscriptions are bought, billed, renewed, cancelled and refunded through Apple's App Store or Google Play, under that store's terms, and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Not a medical device. DeltaLab is a viewer for laboratory data. It does not diagnose, interpret or recommend treatment, and it does not replace the official NHLS report. Results depend on the availability and accuracy of the NHLS portal. All clinical decisions remain the responsibility of the treating clinician.

Cancellation

DeltaLab subscriptions are sold and billed by Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play), not by Facet Software (Pty) Ltd. Your subscription is managed by the store you bought it from, and only that store can cancel it. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.

When you cancel, you keep full access until the end of the period you have already paid for. You will not be charged again, and no partial refund is given for the remaining time. Deleting the App does not cancel your subscription.

To cancel on an iPhone or iPad:

  • open the Settings app;
  • tap your name at the top;
  • tap Subscriptions;
  • tap DeltaLab;
  • tap Cancel Subscription and confirm.

To cancel on Android:

  • open the Google Play Store app;
  • tap your profile icon at the top right;
  • tap Payments & subscriptions, then Subscriptions;
  • tap DeltaLab;
  • tap Cancel subscription and follow the prompts.

You can also reach your store's subscription settings from inside the App: open Settings, then under Subscription tap Manage subscription.

Refunds are handled by the store under its own refund policy. For App Store purchases, request a refund at reportaproblem.apple.com. For Google Play purchases, request a refund through Google Play. Facet Software cannot issue refunds for App Store purchases.

26. Your credentials and patient information

You sign in to DeltaLab with your own NHLS portal username and password. Your credentials are stored in your device's secure storage and are sent only to the NHLS. Patient results you view are stored on your device so they can be reopened quickly, and you can delete them at any time within the App. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential, for protecting your device with a passcode, biometric lock or similar security, and for handling all patient information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (POPIA), your professional and ethical obligations, and your employer's policies.
